title: First-view auto-expand logic in client.gleam update_inner has zero test coverage
evidence: client/src/client.gleam:2989-2990: `let first_view = !set.contains(model.refcheck_auto_expanded, aid)` / `let summary_ids = case first_view {` and :3012 `refcheck_expanded: case first_view {` / :3021 `True -> set.insert(model.refcheck_auto_expanded, aid)`. Verification: `grep -n "refcheck|Refcheck" client/test/client_test.gleam` returns 0 matches — no update_inner test exercises this branch.
detail: AC-stated behaviour ("Given a completed reference, expanded (default on first view)") lives entirely in update_inner; a regression (summaries never auto-expand, or re-expand on return) ships undetected. P2 gap at 0%.
recommended_fix: Add an update_inner test: dispatch ApiReturnedApplicationDetail with a FormCompleted row, assert refcheck_expanded contains the call id and refcheck_auto_expanded gains the aid; re-dispatch and assert collapsed.

title: Route-change reset of refcheck_expanded / refcheck_explainer_open untested
evidence: client/src/client.gleam:653-656: `// Reference panel (RC4.2): collapsed rows don't leak across` / `// applicants. \`refcheck_auto_expanded\` deliberately survives —` / `refcheck_expanded: set.new(),` / `refcheck_explainer_open: False,`. No test in client/test/client_test.gleam references refcheck state (grep: 0 matches).
detail: State-leak class regression (applicant A's expanded rows appearing on applicant B) is unpinned; the reset lines sit in the BrowserChangedUrl branch that has no refcheck assertions. P2 gap at 0%.
recommended_fix: Test BrowserChangedUrl to ApplicationDetail with refcheck_expanded populated and refcheck_explainer_open true; assert both reset.

title: Completed-summary display mappings barely tested: 1 of ~30 choice words, no employer/character slot summaries, no period/amount fallback branches, 6 of 7 signals
evidence: copy.gleam refcheck_choice_word maps 30 wire values (`"yes" -> "Yes"` ... `"as_stated" -> "As stated"` ... `_ -> value`); the only rendered word asserted anywhere is `html |> string.contains("Always on time")` (reference_received_state_test). grep for works_at_confirmed|salary_confirmed|character_statement|would_rehire|known_duration in client/test/ → 0 matches; no assertion checks "In full"/"Good"/"Their landlord"/"Ongoing"/"Don't remember"/"As stated"/"differs" despite fixture values; only fast-completion signal asserted.
detail: A typo in an untested word-map branch ships verbatim to landlords (deposit partly/withheld, period ongoing, amount dont_remember/differs); employer/character key-facts tables and 6 of 7 worth-knowing signals never rendered in a test. P2 gap.
recommended_fix: Table-driven test over every refcheck_choice_word value; add one fixture each for ongoing period, dont_remember amount, as-stated employment/salary, an employer_ref summary, and each remaining signal.

title: v2-reserved Scheduled/Calling/Completed client degradation untested
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:415-421: `// v2-reserved voice lifecycle — never emitted by v1 servers; honest` / `// English renderings so a future payload still degrades gracefully.` / `Scheduled -> #(copy.refcheck_pill_scheduled, pill_slate)` / `Calling -> #(copy.refcheck_pill_calling, pill_navy)` / `Completed -> #(copy.refcheck_pill_received, pill_teal)`. No client test constructs a Scheduled/Calling/Completed row (grep of reference_panel_test.gleam: only FormCompleted etc.).
detail: The degradation path is graceful-by-construction (pill + empty detail), but a label/pill typo there is invisible until a v2 server ships. P3 gap (server hooks matrix does cover these statuses).
recommended_fix: One render test per v2 status asserting pill label, pill colour class, and empty detail region.

title: Malformed result JSON error path in view_completed untested
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:669-672: `case json.parse(text, parsed_result_decoder()) {` / `Error(_) -> element.none()` / `Ok(parsed) -> view_parsed_summary(call, app, parsed)` / `}`. All 26 panel tests feed well-formed result JSON (fixtures are valid JSON strings).
detail: The fail-closed guarantee (no fabricated summary on unparseable data — lens-guard 3) is unpinned client-side; a change that renders raw text or crashes on bad JSON would pass CI. P3 gap.
recommended_fix: Add a test rendering a FormCompleted row with result "{not json" asserting no summary content appears and no crash.

title: aria-expanded="true" flip never asserted
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:284-288: `attribute("aria-expanded", case is_expanded {` / `True -> "true"` / `False -> "false"` / `}),`. The only aria-expanded assertion in the suite: reference_panel_test.gleam:404 `html |> string.contains("aria-expanded=\"false\"") |> should.be_true`.
detail: The a11y contract's expanded-state attribute is half-pinned: expanded tests assert content, not the attribute flip; a regression rendering aria-expanded=false always would pass. P3 gap.
recommended_fix: Assert `aria-expanded="true"` in an expanded-state test (e.g. queued_state_test).

title: Server encoder empty→null branch for form_opened_at/submitted_at unpinned
evidence: encode_reference_call_malformed_attempts_test fixture: `form_opened_at: "",` / `submitted_at: "",` but asserts only `wire |> string.contains("\"attempts\":[]") |> should.be_true`. encode_reference_call_pre_terminal_nullables_test asserts `"form_opened_at":"2026-08-01T21:12:00Z"` present but `grep 'form_opened_at":null|submitted_at":null'` in the file → no match.
detail: The "" → None → null mapping for both additive columns (application_detail_handler.gleam:1185-1192) has no assertion; a regression emitting '' or dropping the keys would pass CI. P3 gap.
recommended_fix: In pre_terminal_nullables_test, add a row with both fields "" and assert `"form_opened_at":null` / `"submitted_at":null` on the wire.

title: No integration coverage for the new server columns (DB → wire)
evidence: Seed INSERT lists: `application_id, ref_slot, owner_label, status, outcome,` / `contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone,` / `attempt_count, next_attempt_at, attempts,` / `form_token, channel, result, fraud_signals,` / `objection_detail` — no form_opened_at/submitted_at; and no assertion in the file mentions either key (grep: 0 matches in the integration suite).
detail: The SQL COALESCE read (list_reference_calls_for_detail.sql:29-36) is never exercised with real values end-to-end; only the encoder is unit-tested with a hand-built row. P3 gap.
recommended_fix: Seed form_opened_at + submitted_at in the fixture and assert both keys carry their values on the detail wire.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: P0 100%: every lens-guard behaviour is pinned — 12-state matrix (labels + pill classes + copy), Off state, pre-v1 hidden card, sub-lines, back-compat decoder (detail_decoder_tolerates_missing_form_opened_at_test), snake_case keys, negative controls (no red, no re-ask, overflow absent on terminal, not-answered, no worth-knowing without signals). Gaps: behaviours 7 and 8 (update_inner auto-expand + route reset) at 0% coverage (client_test.gleam has no refcheck references); behaviour 5 word-map breadth ~1/30 values; behaviour 10 null-branch + behaviour 12 integration unpinned. Overall ≈ 75% (6 FULL + 4 PARTIAL + 2 NONE of 12 behaviours) — below the ≥80% gate.
detail: FAIL per gate thresholds: overall coverage <80%. The load-bearing guards are all tested, but two AC-stated panel behaviours (first-view auto-expand, route-change reset) have no test at all, and the summary word map is sampled, not traced.
recommended_fix: Add the two update_inner tests (auto-expand + reset) and the word-map/signal breadth tests; re-run the gate — with those, P1 and overall both exceed 80%.
